title: Borrower Escrow Statement Auditor
description: Audits a servicer escrow accounting statement from borrower-supplied values only: recomputes the aggregate accounting trial running balance month by month, compares the servicer stated end-of-month balances line by line, flags each discrepant line, checks the stated cushion against the one-sixth-of-annual-disbursements cap, and classifies the recomputed account as balanced, shortage, surplus, or deficiency. Identifier-like fields are refused, never echoed; over 12 monthly periods is refused.

starting_balance.description: Stated opening escrow balance at the start of the computation year, in dollars. Required.

monthly_payments.description: Stated monthly escrow deposit values, one per month, at most 12 entries. Values only - never dates or identifiers.

disbursements.description: Stated monthly escrow disbursement values, one per month, at most 12 entries. Values only.

stated_balances.description: The servicer statement end-of-month balance values, one per month. Compared line by line against the recomputation.

stated_cushion.description: Optional: the servicer stated/target cushion amount. Checked against the one-sixth cap when supplied.

borrower_current.description: Optional: whether the borrower is current at analysis time. A refund-band surplus without it holds the audit for manual review.
